about: OH product imagery for the demo kit (Lane D2, 2026-10-02), and the source for scripts/demo-kit/fetch-imagery.mjs. One hero per product: LG's own product image from LG's media host (media.us.lg.com). For a product whose row in docs/lg/research/lg-taxonomy.json carries an image link (found: taxonomy-link), the same asset at LG's product-page gallery rendition (ecomm-PDPGallery-1100x730) rather than the 350-pixel listing thumbnail the crawl recorded (kept as listed). For a product without one (found: product-page), the first gallery image in the product page's server data that is the product itself, read once per product (pageImage gives its index and LG's alt text). Where the gate rejected a link's image (LG's marketing badges composited beside the product), the page's first clean image replaces it, and why says so. The product list is public/oh/products.json (Lane D1). gate holds the defect-check verdict per file, bound to the sha256 of the exact WebP reviewed. Rendered at 420 square, 88 % fill: WebP and PNG (48-colour palette, dithered) on a transparent ground, a JPEG on white; size and quality chosen so that D1's 602 products, the manifest and the index fit the 25 MB budget with room to spare. unfetched lists the products left without an image.
manifestAbout: Provenance and the defect-check verdict for every image under public/oh/img/. Products are written by scripts/demo-kit/fetch-imagery.mjs from scripts/demo-kit/configs/oh/imagery.json: LG's own product images from LG's media host, one hero per product, crop, scale and ground only. A verdict holds only for the sha256 it was given to; a changed file reads pending. "unfetched" lists the products without an image; they render placeholder-product.svg, a generated placeholder. index.json maps each sku to its entry. No OH page carries an LG mark of its own; LG's marks on its products are part of the product.
